output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is multiplied by 10^uint256(decimals), which can lead to a large number of tokens being created. This can be exploited to increase the balance of any user, allowing attackers to steal funds.
The transfer function does not check if the balance of the target address is sufficient, allowing users to transfer tokens to any address, potentially causing a denial of service attack.
The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The _value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from], allowing a user to burn more tokens than the sender owns, resulting in a loss of funds.
